ramping_up.description: Set the upper bound on a technology's ability to ramp outflow up beyond a certain percentage compared to the previous timestep.
ramping_up.where: (carrier_in OR carrier_out) AND flow_ramping AND NOT timesteps==get_val_at_index(timesteps=0)

carrier_in.description: Carrier(s) consumed by this technology. Only `transmission`, `conversion`, `storage`, and `demand` technologies can define this parameter

carrier_out.description: Carrier(s) produced by this technology. Only `transmission`, `conversion`, `storage`, and `supply` technologies can define this parameter

flow_ramping.description: limit maximum outflow / inflow / outflow - inflow (technology base class dependent) to a fraction of maximum capacity, which increases by that fraction at each timestep.
flow_ramping.title: Ramping rate

flow_cap.description: A technology's flow capacity, also known as its nominal or nameplate capacity.
flow_cap.title: Technology flow (a.k.a. nominal) capacity

flow_in.description: The inflow to a technology per timestep, also known as the flow consumed (by `storage` technologies) or the flow sent (by `transmission` technologies) on a link.
flow_in.title: Carrier inflow
flow_in.where: carrier_in AND not (one_way AND map_dim(nodes, link_to)==True)

flow_out.description: The outflow of a technology per timestep, also known as the flow discharged (from `storage` technologies) or the flow received (by `transmission` technologies) on a link.
flow_out.title: Carrier outflow
flow_out.where: carrier_out AND not (one_way AND map_dim(nodes, link_from)==True)
